blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios.
In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision.
We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher–student competence gap.
We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics.
Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.
blocks.zh:
光学字符识别(OCR)正在从纯文本的转录发展到一般的视觉智能,要求模型在复杂的视觉环境中识别,本地化和理性比文字信息更强. 然而,现有的OCR系统往往只在一些任务上表现优异,并努力平衡各种设想的承认、分析和推理。
在本报告中,我们介绍PolyOCR,这是一个由不同规模的统一的OCR基金会模型组成的家族. PolyOCR将一个遵循共享指令的框架与一个大型数据引擎相结合,将各种视觉资源转换成质量验证的OCR监督.
我们引入了能力指导政策优化,通过基于教师可靠性和师生能力差距的抽样路径将基于核查者的团队相对政策优化与政策提炼相结合。
我们还采用了OCR Bench v2.1, 我们修改了OCR Bench v2, 并用人工核实的注释校正和任务对应的评分指标。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) ( Long et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) has evolved from conventional text transcription toward text-centric visual intelligence ( Qu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Traditional OCR systems mainly focus on converting text-containing images into machine-readable representations through modular pipelines consisting of text detection and recognition ( Chaudhuri et al., 2016 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) . Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially expanded OCR capabilities beyond isolated recognition, enabling scene-text understanding, spatial localization, document structure recovery, table and formula parsing, information extraction, and OCR-oriented reasoning ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Qu et al., 2026c ) . As OCR increasingly serves as an interface between visual documents and intelligent systems, future OCR models require not only accurate text recognition but also broad capability coverage and robust generalization across diverse text-centric scenarios.
blocks.zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)(Long et al., 2021;Zhang et al., 2024a)已经从常规文本转录到文本中心视觉智能(Qu et al., 2023; Chen et al., 2024). 传统 OCR系统主要侧重于通过包含文本检测和识别的模块化管道将含有文本的图像转换为机器可读表示(Chaudhuri等人,2016年;Wei等人,2024年). 最近在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)方面取得的进展大大扩展了OCR的能力,使其超越了孤立的识别,使得能够了解场景文本、空间定位、文件结构恢复、表格和公式解析、信息提取以及面向OCR的推理(Fu等人,2025年;Team等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a;Qu等人,2026年c). 随着OCR日益成为视觉文件与智能系统之间的接口,未来的OCR模型不仅需要准确的文本识别,而且需要广泛的能力覆盖,并强有力地概括各种以文本为中心的情景。

blocks.en: Despite significant progress, existing OCR systems remain limited in achieving such unified capabilities. Current approaches mainly follow two paradigms. The first consists of specialized OCR systems optimized for specific domains or task families, such as scene text recognition, document parsing, table understanding, and structured information extraction ( Team et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Although these systems achieve strong performance within their target settings, their task formulations, architectures, supervision schemes, and output formats are often highly specialized, resulting in fragmented capability development and limited knowledge transfer across heterogeneous OCR scenarios. The second paradigm is represented by general-purpose MLLMs, which provide unified interfaces and strong semantic reasoning abilities. However, OCR capabilities in these models are typically acquired implicitly through broad multimodal pretraining rather than systematically optimized across fine-grained text-centric tasks ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) . Consequently, they may exhibit uneven performance in precise text recognition, spatial grounding, dense document understanding, and structured content extraction. These limitations reveal a fundamental challenge in balancing capability breadth, task-specific accuracy, and cross-scenario generalization within a single OCR model.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了重大进展,但在实现这种统一能力方面,现有的OCR系统仍然有限。 目前的办法主要遵循两个模式。 第一个系统是为特定领域或任务家庭优化的专门OCR系统,如现场文本识别、文件解析、表理解和结构化信息提取(Team等人,2025年;Cui等人,2025年b;Zhang等人,2026年b;Zhong等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a). 尽管这些系统在其目标环境内取得了强劲的业绩,但其任务制定、架构、监督计划和产出格式往往高度专业化,导致能力发展分散,不同业务记录和记录制度不同情况之间的知识转让有限。 第二个范式由通用的MLLMs代表,它提供统一的接口和强大的语义推理能力. 然而,这些模型中的OCR能力通常通过广泛的多式联运预训而含蓄地获得,而不是系统地优化精细的文字中心任务(Achiam等人,2023年;Bai等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年a). 因此,在准确的文字识别、空间定位、对文件的密集理解和结构化内容提取方面,它们的表现可能参差不齐。 这些限制表明,在单一的OCR模型内平衡能力宽度、具体任务的准确性以及跨情景的概括性方面存在着根本的挑战。

blocks.en: Building a unified OCR foundation model also introduces substantial training challenges. OCR-related tasks differ significantly in visual complexity, output structure, supervision granularity, and optimization objectives. Text recognition requires precise sequence generation, localization requires spatially grounded prediction, structured extraction requires strict format consistency, and OCR-centric reasoning emphasizes semantic understanding. Directly combining these heterogeneous tasks with fixed sampling strategies or static optimization objectives may lead to imbalanced learning dynamics, where dominant tasks overwhelm underrepresented or difficult capabilities. Moreover, positive transfer and task interference can coexist during multi-task learning, while sequential adaptation may cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired competencies ( Standley et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2020 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xin et al., 2026b ; Xin et al., 2026a ) . Therefore, an effective OCR foundation model requires not only a unified task formulation but also an adaptive training strategy that coordinates heterogeneous supervision and maintains balanced capability acquisition.
blocks.zh: 建立一个统一的OCR基金会模式也带来了实质性的培训挑战。 OCR相关任务在视觉复杂度,输出结构,监督颗粒度,以及优化目标等方面差异很大. 文本识别需要精确的序列生成,本地化需要空间基础的预测,结构提取需要严格的格式一致性,OCR-中心推理强调语义理解. 直接将这些千差万别的任务与固定的抽样战略或静态优化目标结合起来,可能导致学习动态失衡,因为主导任务压倒代表性不足或困难的能力。 此外,在多任务学习期间,积极转移和任务干扰可以共存,而顺序调整可能导致灾难性地忘记先前获得的能力(Standley等人,2020年;Yu等人,2020年;Zhu等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年;Xin等人,2026年b;Xin等人,2026年a). 因此,有效的OCR基础模式不仅需要统一的任务拟订,还需要适应性培训战略,协调各种监督并保持均衡的能力获取。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models with 2B and 9B parameter variants built upon Qwen3.5. PolyOCR reformulates heterogeneous OCR and OCR-centric understanding tasks within a shared instruction-following and autoregressive generation framework. Through this unified formulation, diverse outputs, including text transcriptions, spatial coordinates, structured records, document representations, tables, formulas, translations, and open-form answers, can be generated through a common interface, enabling knowledge sharing across text recognition, text localization, document parsing, information extraction, visual text understanding, and OCR reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提出了PolyOCR,这是一个以Quen3.5为基础的2B和9B参数变体的统一的OCR基础模型家族. PolyOCR在一个遵循共同指令和自动生成框架内重构各种不同的OCR和OCR中心理解任务。 通过这种统一的配制,可以通过一个共同的界面生成多种产出,包括文本抄录、空间坐标、结构化记录、文档表述、表格、公式、翻译和开放式答案,从而能够在文本识别、文本本地化、文档解析、信息提取、视觉文本理解和OCR推理之间分享知识。

blocks.en: To enable such broad capability coverage, we develop a large-scale OCR data engine that addresses the limited coverage and imbalance of existing public and internal OCR datasets. The data engine converts heterogeneous visual assets into quality-verified supervision through controllable synthesis and model-assisted annotation, with particular emphasis on underrepresented scenarios and complex OCR capabilities that are insufficiently covered by existing resources. We further introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO), a competence-aware post-training framework that integrates verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation. CGPO dynamically adjusts the distillation weight according to teacher reliability and the evolving teacher–student competence gap, enabling selective and efficient utilization of teacher supervision.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这种广泛的能力覆盖,我们开发了一个大型OCR数据引擎,处理现有公共和内部OCR数据集的有限覆盖和不平衡问题。 数据引擎通过可控合成和模型辅助注释,将各种视觉资产转换为质量验证的监督,特别强调代表性不足的假想和复杂的OCR能力,而现有资源没有足够覆盖。 我们还引入了能力指导政策优化(CGPO),这是一个注重能力的培训后框架,将基于核查者的小组相对政策优化与政策提炼相结合。 CGPO根据教师的可靠性和不断演变的师生能力差距,动态调整蒸馏重量,从而能够有选择和有效地利用教师的监管。

blocks.en: To further extend multilingual document parsing capabilities, we additionally introduce PolyOCR-2.7B, a specialized configuration combining a 1.2B-parameter ViT vision encoder with a 1.5B-parameter Qwen2.5 text decoder. Trained on a curated in-house corpus covering 21 language/script groups, this variant is optimized for robust performance across diverse writing systems and acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步扩大多语种文档解析能力,我们又引入了PolyOCR-2.7B,这是一种专门配置,将1.2B参数的ViT视觉编码器与1.5B参数的Quen2.5文本解码器结合在一起. 这一变体对21个语言/文字组进行了内部教材培训,以适应不同书写系统和获取条件的强劲表现。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance across diverse OCR scenarios. The model family exhibits strong and balanced capabilities spanning text recognition, text localization, document parsing, information extraction, visual text understanding, and OCR reasoning, establishing the effectiveness of the proposed unified OCR training framework. The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 关于OCR Bench v2.1, CC-OCR, 内部KIE Bactor, OmniDoc Bench v1.6和MDP Bench的广泛实验表明,PolyOCR在各种OCR情景中实现了最先进的或高度竞争性的性能. 示范家庭表现出强大和平衡的能力,包括文本识别、文本本地化、文件解析、信息提取、视觉文本理解和OCR推理,确立了拟议的统一OCR培训框架的有效性。 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models that integrate text recognition, text localization, document parsing, information extraction, visual text understanding, and OCR reasoning within a unified generative framework. The family includes general-purpose variants and a specialized multilingual configuration (PolyOCR-2.7B) optimized for diverse writing systems. • We develop a large-scale OCR data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-controlled multi-task supervision through task-oriented construction, synthesis, and verification. Furthermore, we contribute to the community with refined and comprehensive benchmarks, including OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench, to facilitate rigorous evaluation across general, multilingual, and industrial OCR scenarios. • We propose Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO), a competence-aware post-training framework that dynamically combines verifier-based policy optimization and on-policy distillation through sample-wise supervision routing, effectively balancing heterogeneous task learning and preventing catastrophic forgetting.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Specialized OCR Systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 专门的OCR系统

blocks.en: Optical Character Recognition has traditionally been developed through task-specific formulations, including text detection, recognition, text spotting, handwriting recognition, multilingual OCR, and mathematical expression recognition ( Long et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) . Early OCR systems commonly adopted modular pipelines, where text localization, visual recognition, and post-processing were optimized independently. Representative approaches such as EAST ( Zhou et al., 2017 ) and CRNN ( Shi et al., 2016 ) established effective paradigms for scene-text detection and recognition, while recent Transformer-based models, including TrOCR ( Li et al., 2023 ) and PARSeq ( Bautista and Atienza, 2022 ) , further improved recognition accuracy through large-scale pretraining and sequence modeling.
blocks.zh: 光学字符 传统上通过特定任务的表达方式来发展识别,包括文本检测,识别,文本标注,笔迹识别,多语种OCR,以及数学表达识别(Long等人,2021年;Zhang等人,2024年a). 早点 OCR系统通常采用模块化管道,其中文本本地化,视觉识别和后处理被独立优化. 东方(周等人,2017年)和CRNN(史等人,2016年)等代表性方法为场景文字检测和识别确立了有效的范式,而最近的变形器模型,包括TrOCR(李等人,2023年)和PARSeq(鲍蒂斯塔和阿蒂安扎,2022年),通过大规模预训和测序模型,进一步提高了识别精度.

blocks.en: Beyond text recognition, specialized OCR models have been developed for diverse scenarios ( Qu et al., 2025a ; Qu et al., 2024a ) , including handwriting recognition, multilingual text understanding, formula recognition, text spotting, and structured information extraction. These systems typically employ task-specific architectures, supervision formats, decoding mechanisms, and evaluation protocols tailored to individual objectives. Although such specialization enables strong performance within specific domains, it also leads to fragmented capability development, where knowledge learned from one OCR task is difficult to transfer to others with different visual characteristics, output structures, and reasoning requirements.
blocks.zh: 除了文本识别外,还为各种情景(Qu等人,2025a;Qu等人,2024a)开发了专门的OCR模型,包括笔迹识别、多语种文本理解、公式识别、文本定位和结构化信息提取。 这些系统通常采用针对具体任务的架构,监督格式,解码机制,以及适合个别目标的评价协议. 虽然这种专业化能够在特定领域产生强有力的业绩,但也导致能力零散发展,从一项OCR任务中学到的知识难以转让给其他具有不同视觉特征、产出结构和推理要求的知识。

blocks.en: The increasing diversity of OCR applications calls for a unified modeling paradigm that learns heterogeneous OCR capabilities within a shared framework ( Qu et al., 2024b ; Qu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: OCR应用日益多样化,需要有一个统一的模型模式,在共同框架内学习不同的OCR能力(Qu等人,2024b;Qu等人,2026b)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Document Intelligence Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 文件情报模式

blocks.en: Document intelligence extends OCR from isolated text recognition toward page-level understanding, including layout analysis, reading-order modeling, structured reconstruction, and semantic information extraction ( Qu et al., 2026d ) . Early approaches such as LayoutLM ( Xu et al., 2020 ) and LayoutLMv3 ( Huang et al., 2022 ) jointly modeled textual, visual, and spatial information, enabling effective document-level representation learning.
blocks.zh: 文件智能将OCR从孤立的文本识别延伸到页面层次的理解,包括布局分析,读序建模,结构重建,以及语义信息提取(Qu等人,2026d). 早期方法如布局LM(徐等人,2020年)和布局LMv3(黄等人,2022年)联合建模文本,视觉,空间信息,使文件层面的有效表达学习成为可能.

blocks.en: Another line of research explores OCR-free document understanding, where document images are directly converted into structured outputs without explicit OCR modules. Donut ( Kim et al., 2022 ) introduced an end-to-end document understanding framework based on image-to-sequence generation, while Nougat ( Blecher et al., 2024 ) focused on converting scientific documents into structured markup representations. Recent document parsing systems further improve full-page understanding through structure-aware modeling and large-scale multimodal training, including MonkeyOCR ( Li et al., 2025 ) , Dolphin ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) , MinerU2.5 ( Niu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , and PaddleOCR-VL ( Cui et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 另一行研究探索了OCR无线文档的理解,其中文档图像直接转换成结构化的输出,没有明确的OCR模块. 多努特(Kim等人,2022年)引入了基于图像到序列生成的端对端文件理解框架,而努加特(Blecher等人,2024年)则专注于将科学文件转换成结构化的标记表示. 最近的文件解析系统通过结构意识模型和大规模多式联运培训,包括MonkeyOCR,进一步提高了全页理解. (Li等人,2025年),海豚. (Feng等人,2025年;Feng等人,2026年),MinerU2.5(Niu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a),和PaddleOCR-VL(Cui等人,2025年a; 张等, 2026b ).

blocks.en: Despite significant progress in document-level understanding, existing document intelligence models primarily optimize for page-centric scenarios. Their capabilities are often concentrated on layout analysis, structural reconstruction, and document semantic extraction, while broader OCR intelligence, including natural-scene text perception, multilingual recognition, region-conditioned understanding, and OCR-oriented reasoning across heterogeneous visual environments, remains insufficiently unified.
blocks.zh: 尽管在文件层面的理解方面取得了重大进展,但现有的文件智能模型主要为以页面为中心的情景进行优化。 他们的能力往往集中在布局分析、结构重建和文件语义提取,而更广泛的OCR智能,包括自然-场景文本感知、多语种识别、基于区域条件的理解以及跨不同视觉环境的面向OCR的推理仍然不够统一。

blocks.en: 2.3 OCR-oriented Vision-Language Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 面向OCR的愿景-语言基础模型

blocks.en: The emergence of multimodal large language models provides a unified generative paradigm for visual perception, language understanding, spatial reasoning, and structured output generation. General-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and Ovis2.5 ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , demonstrate strong capabilities across a wide range of visual understanding tasks. By adopting instruction following as a common interface, these models can flexibly handle image understanding, visual question answering, grounding, and document-related tasks within a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型的出现为视觉感知,语言理解,空间推理,以及结构化输出生成提供了统一的基因模式. 通用视觉语言模型,包括双子座(Comanici等人,2025年),Quen3-VL(Bai等人,2025年),InternVL3.5(Wang等人,2025年b),以及Ovis2.5(Lu等人,2025年),在广泛的视觉理解任务中表现出强大的能力. 这些模型通过采用遵循作为共同界面的指令,可以在统一框架内灵活处理图像理解、视觉问题回答、定位和文档相关任务。

blocks.en: Despite their broad multimodal capabilities, OCR competence in general-purpose vision-language models is typically acquired as an auxiliary capability from large-scale multimodal pretraining rather than through systematic optimization over diverse text-centric tasks. As a result, these models often exhibit uneven performance across fine-grained character recognition, dense text perception, precise localization, structured information extraction, and document-level reasoning. Comprehensive OCR evaluations, including OCRBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and OCRBench v2 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , reveal substantial performance variations among different OCR capability dimensions, indicating that a unified multimodal interface alone is insufficient to establish balanced OCR intelligence.
blocks.zh: 尽管具有广泛的多式联运能力,但一般情况下,通过大规模多式联运预训,而不是通过系统优化各种以文字为中心的任务,获取了通用视觉语言模型的OCR能力。 因此,这些模型在精细的字符识别,密密的文本感知,精确的本地化,结构化的信息提取,以及文档层次的推理之间往往表现出不均匀的表现. OCR综合评价,包括OCR Bench(Liu等人,2024年)和OCR Bench v2(Fu等人,2025年),揭示了不同OCR能力维度之间的巨大性能差异,表明单靠统一的多式联运接口不足以建立平衡的OCR智能.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, recent studies have explored OCR-oriented vision-language models that explicitly optimize text-centric visual understanding. TextMonkey ( Liu et al., 2026 ) improves high-resolution text perception and grounding through OCR-oriented visual modeling. GOT-OCR2.0 ( Wei et al., 2024 ) extends OCR beyond plain-text transcription by supporting recognition, formulas, tables, charts, and region-conditioned understanding within a unified generative framework. HunyuanOCR ( Team et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) integrates text spotting, document parsing, information extraction, translation, and OCR-oriented question answering into a single OCR model. OCRVerse ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) and Qianfan-OCR ( Dong et al., 2026 ) further expand OCR vision-language modeling toward broader task coverage and structured visual-text understanding.
blocks.zh: 为了消除这一局限性,最近的研究探索了明确优化文本中心视觉理解的面向OCR的视觉语言模型. TextMonkey (Liu et al., 2026)通过面向OCR的视觉模型,提高了高分辨率文本感知度和地面. GOT-OCR2.0(Wei等人,2024年)将OCR扩展至纯文本的转录之外,在一个统一的基因框架内支持识别、公式、表格、图表和区域有条件的理解。 HunyuanOCR(Team等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a)将文本抽查,文档解析,信息提取,翻译,面向OCR的问题解答整合为单一的OCR模型. OCRVerse(Zhong等人,2026年)和Qianfan-OCR(Dong等人,2026年)进一步扩大OCR视觉语言模型,向更广泛的任务覆盖范围和结构化视觉文字理解发展.

blocks.en: These OCR-oriented vision-language models represent an important transition from isolated OCR modules toward unified generative OCR systems. Nevertheless, existing approaches still differ in their primary optimization objectives, with some emphasizing recognition and grounding, some focusing on document parsing, and others targeting selected extraction or reasoning tasks. A comprehensive OCR foundation model requires further integration of heterogeneous OCR capabilities, balanced supervision across diverse tasks, and adaptive optimization strategies that can maintain consistent performance from low-level text perception to high-level visual-text reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这些面向OCR的视觉语言模型代表着从孤立的OCR模块向统一的基因OCR系统的重要过渡. 尽管如此,现有方法在首要优化目标上仍然有所不同,有些强调确认和基础,有些侧重于文件解析,另一些则针对选定的提取或推理任务。 一个全面的OCR基础模型需要进一步整合不同的OCR能力,平衡地监督不同的任务,以及适应性优化战略,以保持从低水平文本感知到高水平视觉文本推理的一贯性能.

blocks.en: 2.4 OCR Data Construction and Capability-aware Post-training
blocks.zh: 2.4 OCR系统 数据建设和能力意识

blocks.en: The development of OCR foundation models relies on large-scale and diverse supervision. Existing approaches typically combine manually annotated datasets with web-collected documents, scanned books, natural scene images, synthetic text images, rendered tables and formulas, automatically parsed documents, and model-generated instruction data ( Cui et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026a ; Jiang et al., 2026b ) . Synthetic generation and model-assisted annotation have become important for expanding coverage of long-tail scenarios, complex layouts, and structured output formats. However, constructing large-scale OCR supervision remains challenging due to annotation cost, heterogeneous task requirements, and the difficulty of maintaining consistent quality across diverse sources.
blocks.zh: OCR基金会模型的发展依赖于大规模和多样化的监督. 现有办法通常将人工附加说明的数据集与网络收集的文件、扫描书籍、自然场景图像、合成文本图像、制成的表格和公式、自动解析的文件以及模型生成的指令数据相结合(Cui等人,2025b); Wang et al., 2026a; Dong et al., 2026; Jiang et al., 2026a; Jiang et al. 2026b ). 合成生成和模型辅助注释对于扩大长尾假想,复杂布局,结构化输出格式的覆盖范围已变得重要. 然而,由于说明费用、不同任务要求以及不同来源之间难以保持一致的质量,建造大规模OCR监督仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Recent OCR-oriented models commonly adopt multi-task supervised fine-tuning to align pretrained multimodal models with heterogeneous OCR tasks and output formats ( Li et al., ) . Knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning have further been explored to improve recognition accuracy, structural validity, and instruction-following ability ( Team et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, OCR tasks differ substantially in data availability, visual complexity, annotation reliability, and optimization difficulty. Fixed data sampling strategies or static loss weighting may lead to imbalanced capability acquisition, where frequently optimized tasks dominate training while challenging or underrepresented capabilities remain insufficiently learned.
blocks.zh: 最近面向OCR的模型通常采用多任务监督的微调,使经过预先培训的多式联运模型与不同的OCR任务和输出格式保持一致(Li等人)。 进一步探索了知识蒸馏和强化学习,以提高识别准确性、结构有效性和遵循教学的能力(Team等人,2025年;Li等人,2026a年); 张等, 2026b; 钟等, 2026). 尽管如此,OCR的任务在数据可用性,视觉复杂度,注释可靠性,优化难度等方面却大相径庭. 固定数据抽样战略或静态损失权重可能导致能力获取不平衡,在培训中往往以优化任务为主,而挑战性或代表性不足的能力仍然缺乏足够的知识。

blocks.en: Recent OCR training pipelines provide more direct precedents for outcome optimization and distillation. olmOCR 2 uses the pass rate of verifiable unit tests as a GRPO reward, assessing text fidelity, reading order, table relations, and formula rendering ( Poznanski et al., 2025 ) . Infinity-Parser2 performs joint reinforcement learning over eight document and multimodal tasks with task-specific rewards for textual, spatial, and structural accuracy ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . OvisOCR2 transfers an RL-enhanced 4B teacher to a 0.8B student through on-policy distillation with a reverse-KL objective evaluated on the student’s top- k k support ( Lu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近OCR培训管道为成果优化和提炼提供了更直接的先例. olmOCR 2使用可核查的单位测试的通过率作为GRPO奖励,评估文本的忠实性,读取顺序,表层关系,以及公式渲染(波兹南斯基等人,2025年). Infinity-Parser2在8份文件和多式联运任务中进行联合强化学习,对文字、空间和结构准确性给予具体任务奖励(Huang等人,2026年)。 OvisOCR2通过政策提炼,将一名RL增强型4B型教师转移给一名0.8B型学生,目标为反向KL,评价该学生的顶级支持(Lu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Beyond OCR, generalized knowledge distillation (GKD) already combines reinforcement learning with on-policy teacher supervision ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . More recent methods make this supervision conditional on observed outcomes: SCOPE routes verified student trajectories to perplexity-weighted self-reinforcement or distillation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , whereas Reward-Gated OPD selects trajectories according to agreement between verifier feedback and the teacher–student likelihood gap ( Akhondzadeh et al., 2026 ) . CGPO instead estimates competence from teacher and student generations scored against a shared reference, calibrates teacher quality and probability of superiority on held-out generations, and uses the resulting sample-level weight to modulate OPD alongside an always-active GRPO objective.
blocks.zh: 除了OCR外,通用知识蒸馏(GKD)已经结合强化学习与政策教师监督(Agarwal等人,2024年). 最近的方法使这种监督以观察到的结果为条件: SCOPE通过校验学生的轨迹,使其达到复杂加权的自我强化或蒸馏(Zheng等人,2026年),而Reward-Ged OPD则根据校验者反馈与教师的协议选择轨迹-学生概率差距(Akhondzadeh等人,2026年)。 相反,CGPO对照一个共同的参照标准来估计师生世代的能力,校准教师的素质和在被搁置的几代人中优异的概率,并利用由此产生的样本级权重来调制OPD和始终活跃的GRPO目标.

blocks.en: Adaptive optimization methods have been investigated in broader multi-task and model training scenarios ( Qu et al., 2026a ; Qu et al., 2025b ) . TwSG ( Jiang et al., 2026c ) proposes the TL-GRPO scheme to optimize model performance on text-intensive understanding tasks such as ChartQA. GradNorm ( Chen et al., 2018 ) balances task losses according to learning dynamics, PCGrad ( Yu et al., 2020 ) mitigates gradient conflicts, DoReMi ( Xie et al., 2023 ) optimizes data mixtures through distribution reweighting, and Skill-it! ( Chen et al., 2023 ) adapts training schedules according to skill dependencies. However, these approaches mainly focus on task balancing, data allocation, or curriculum design, without explicitly modeling the evolving competence relationship between teacher and student models during OCR-specific post-training ( Yu et al., 2024 ) . Building unified OCR foundation models therefore requires both comprehensive supervision and capability-aware optimization strategies that can adaptively allocate learning signals according to model competence.
blocks.zh: 在更广泛的多任务和模式培训设想中调查了适应性优化方法(Qu等人,2026a;Qu等人,2025b)。 TwSG(Jiang et al., 2026c)提出TL-GRPO计划,以优化图QA等文本密集型理解任务的模型性能. GradNorm(Chen等人,2018年)根据学习动态平衡任务损失,PCGrad(Yu等人,2020年)缓解梯度冲突,DoReMi(Xie等人,2023年)通过分布重量优化数据混合物,Skill-it! (Chen等人,2023年)根据技能依赖性调整培训时间表. 然而,这些方法主要侧重于任务平衡、数据分配或课程设计,而没有明确模拟教师和学生模式在OCR特定后培训期间不断发展的能力关系(Yu等人,2024年)。 因此,建立统一的OCR基础模型需要全面监督和能力意识优化战略,这些战略能够根据模型能力适应性地分配学习信号。

blocks.en: 3 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3个 数据构建

blocks.en: A unified OCR foundation model requires large-scale and diverse supervision that covers the full spectrum of text-centric visual intelligence capabilities, ranging from fundamental text recognition and spatial localization to structured content recovery, information extraction, multilingual transformation, and OCR-oriented reasoning. However, existing OCR datasets are typically constructed for individual tasks, visual domains, or languages, resulting in fragmented capability coverage and imbalanced supervision across different OCR scenarios.
blocks.zh: 统一的OCR基础模型需要大规模多样的监督,涵盖文字中心视觉智能的全部范围,从基本文本识别和空间本地化到结构化的内容恢复,信息提取,多语种转换,以及面向OCR的推理. 然而,现有的OCR数据集通常是为单个任务,视觉域或语言而构建的,导致能力覆盖范围分散,不同OCR情景的监督不平衡.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we develop a comprehensive data construction framework consisting of two complementary components: full-spectrum OCR data collection and targeted capability-driven data construction. First, we curate large-scale public datasets and in-house resources to establish broad coverage across OCR tasks, visual environments, languages, and annotation formats. Second, for capabilities that remain underrepresented due to limited public resources or expensive annotation requirements, we develop a targeted data-construction engine that generates controllable synthetic and model-assisted supervision. Together, these two components provide a unified and scalable data foundation for training OCR foundation models.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们制定了由两个互补部分组成的全面数据构建框架:全光谱OCR数据收集和有针对性的能力驱动数据构建。 首先,我们管理大规模公共数据集和内部资源,以便在OCR任务、视觉环境、语言和注释格式方面建立广泛的覆盖面。 第二,对于由于公共资源有限或说明要求昂贵而仍然代表性不足的能力,我们开发一种有针对性的数据建设引擎,产生可控制的合成和模型辅助监督。 这两个组成部分共同为训练OCR基础模型提供了一个统一和可扩展的数据基础.

blocks.en: 3.1 Full-Spectrum OCR Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 完全定型 OCR 数据收集

blocks.en: Inspired by Venus-DeFakerOne ( Team, 2026 ) , to establish broad capability coverage for unified OCR training, we curate OCR data from diverse visual domains and organize them according to six fundamental capability dimensions: text recognition, text localization, document parsing, information extraction, visual text understanding, and OCR reasoning. We use these six dimensions as a benchmark-independent organization of the training corpus. Figure 2 illustrates representative tasks within these dimensions, and Table 1 summarizes their organization in the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 受Venus-DeFaker One(Team,2026年)的启发,为建立统一OCR培训的广泛能力覆盖范围,我们从各种视觉领域整理OCR数据,并按照六个基本能力维度加以组织:文本识别,文本本地化,文档解析,信息提取,视觉文本理解,以及OCR推理. 我们把这六个方面作为培训大纲的独立基准组织。 图2显示了这些方面的代表性任务,表1概述了这些任务在培训机构内的组织情况。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Representative tasks across the six OCR capability dimensions. Each card pairs an example image with a shortened instruction. The gallery combines task illustrations from Table 16 with selected examples from OCRBench v2 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ; the displayed examples illustrate task definitions rather than the composition of the training corpus.
blocks.zh: 图2:代表六个OCR能力层面的任务。 每张卡片配对一个带有缩短指令的示例图像. 展馆将表16中的任务插图与OCR Bench v2(Fu等人,2025年)中的一些例子结合起来;所展示的例子说明了任务定义,而不是培训的构成.

blocks.en: The examples illustrate how a visual domain can support different tasks: a document may require transcription, structure recovery, field extraction, or question answering. Organizing data by the requested operation distinguishes these supervision requirements while retaining coverage across scenes, documents, charts, and application interfaces.
blocks.zh: 实例说明一个视觉域如何支持不同的任务:文档可能需要抄写,结构恢复,字段提取,或回答问题. 所要求操作组织的数据区分了这些监督要求,同时保留了整个场景、文件、图表和应用程序接口的覆盖。

blocks.en: This category covers fundamental text perception capabilities across different visual conditions and granularity levels, including printed text recognition, scene text recognition, handwriting recognition, multilingual recognition, curved text recognition, and dense document transcription. The collected supervision spans character-, word-, line-, paragraph-, and page-level recognition tasks ( Ying et al., 2026 ; Karatzas et al., 2015 ; Ch’ng and Chan, 2017 ; Marti and Bunke, 2002 ; Liu et al., 2019 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一类涵盖不同视觉条件和颗粒度层次的基本文本感知能力,包括印刷文本识别,场景文本识别,笔迹识别,多语种识别,曲线文本识别,以及密集的文档抄录. 收集的监督范围包括人物,字,行,段,和页级识别任务(Ying等人,2026年;Karatzas等人,2015年;Ch'ng and Chan,2017年;Marti and Bunke,2002年;Liu等人,2019年;Jiang等人,2023年;Yuan等人,2022年).

blocks.en: This category focuses on spatially grounded text understanding, including text detection, text grounding, referring text localization, region-conditioned recognition, and text spotting. The corresponding annotations provide explicit spatial supervision represented by bounding boxes, quadrilaterals, or polygons, enabling joint learning of textual content and spatial information ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ; Ch’ng and Chan, 2017 ; Veit et al., 2016 ; Long et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一类别侧重于对文本的空间理解,包括文本检测、文本定位、文本本地化、区域有条件的识别和文本示意图。 相应的说明提供了以边框、四边形或多边形为代表的明确的空间监督,使得能够共同学习文字内容和空间信息(Karatzas等人,2015年;Ch'ng和Chan,2017年;Veit等人,2016年;Long等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: This category includes document layout analysis, reading-order recovery, full-page document parsing, table reconstruction, chart parsing, and mathematical expression recognition. These tasks require models to recover hierarchical document structures beyond plain-text transcription, including both printed and handwritten mathematical content ( Zhong et al., 2019 ; Zhong et al., 2020 ; Smock et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2023 ; Gervais et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一类包括文档布局分析,读序恢复,整页文档解析,表格重建,图表解析,以及数学表达式识别. 这些任务需要模型在纯文本抄录之外恢复层次文件结构,包括印刷和手写数学内容(钟等,2019;钟等,2020;斯莫克等,2022;程等,2023;Gervais等,2024).

blocks.en: This category covers structured information understanding from visually rich documents, including entity extraction, key information extraction, key–value association, form understanding, and semantic relation recovery from receipts, forms, certificates, and other structured document images ( Jaume et al., 2019 ; Huang et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Kuang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一类别包括从视觉丰富的文件中对结构化信息的理解,包括实体提取、关键信息提取、关键价值关联、形式理解以及从收据、表格、证书和其他结构化文件图像中恢复语义关系(Jaume等人,2019年;Huang等人,2019年;徐等人,2022年;Kuang等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: This category extends OCR beyond perception toward higher-level visual-text interaction, including scene and document question answering, document classification, chart and table understanding, diagram interpretation, and visual text translation. These tasks require models to interpret textual information in the context of surrounding visual structures and perform task-oriented transformations ( Singh et al., 2019 ; Biten et al., 2019 ; Mathew et al., 2021 ; Masry et al., 2022 ; Mishra et al., 2019 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 这一类将OCR扩展至超越感知的更高层次的视觉文本交互,包括场景和文档问答,文档分类,图表和表格理解,图解,视觉文本翻译. 这些任务需要模型在周边视觉结构中解释文字信息,并进行面向任务的转变(Singh等人,2019年;Biten等人,2019年;Mathew等人,2021年;Masry等人,2022年;Mishra等人,2019年;梁等人,2024年).

blocks.en: This category targets reasoning capabilities grounded in visual text, including character and text-instance counting, arithmetic operations over visible values, spatial relationship reasoning, scientific question answering, and multi-step reasoning over scenes, documents, tables, charts, diagrams, and application interfaces ( Masry et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 本类针对基于视觉文字的推理能力,包括性格和文字内置计数,算术操作高于可见值,空间关系推理,科学问题回答,以及场景,文档,表格,图表,图表,应用界面的多步骤推理(Masry等人,2022年;Lu等人,2022年;Lu等人,2024年;张等人,2024年b).

blocks.en: Although the collected corpus provides broad coverage across OCR tasks and visual scenarios, naturally available datasets remain highly imbalanced. In particular, capabilities such as spatially grounded bilingual translation, template-based key information extraction, Chinese document and table parsing, scene-text localization, and OCR-centric reasoning lack sufficient high-quality supervision due to limited public resources or expensive annotation processes. Therefore, we further develop a targeted data-construction engine to generate controllable synthetic and model-assisted training data for these underrepresented capabilities.
blocks.zh: 虽然收集的数据包广泛涵盖OCR任务和视觉情景,但自然可以得到的数据集仍然高度不平衡。 特别是,由于公共资源有限或注释过程昂贵,空间化双语翻译、模板关键信息提取、中国文件和表格解析、场景文本本地化和以OCR为中心的推理等能力缺乏足够的高质量监督。 因此,我们进一步开发一个有针对性的数据建设引擎,为这些代表性不足的能力生成可控制的合成和模型辅助培训数据。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Capability organization of the full-spectrum OCR training corpus.
blocks.zh: 表1:全谱OCR培训机构的能力组织。

blocks.en: 3.2 Targeted Data-Construction Engine
blocks.zh: 3.2 目标数据构建引擎

blocks.en: Although full-spectrum data collection provides broad OCR coverage, naturally available datasets remain insufficient for several capabilities due to limited annotations and high labeling costs. To address these gaps, we develop a targeted data-construction engine that generates capability-specific synthetic and model-assisted supervision. Each pipeline is designed to preserve the semantic requirements, spatial constraints, and output formats of its target OCR task.
blocks.zh: 虽然全光谱数据收集提供了广泛的OCR覆盖范围,但由于说明有限和标签费用高,自然可用的数据集仍然不足以提供几种能力. 为了弥补这些差距,我们开发了一个有针对性的数据建设引擎,以产生针对具体能力的合成和模型辅助监督。 每个管道的设计都是为了保留其目标OCR任务的语义要求,空间限制,以及输出格式.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , the engine decouples raw visual resources from task-specific supervision generation. Diverse sources, including street images, document templates, annual reports, books, PDFs, tables, and verified OCR annotations, are transformed into supervision for scene-text understanding, bilingual translation, key information extraction, document parsing, table understanding, and OCR-centric reasoning. The engine is organized into three complementary synthesis pipelines: scene-text and translation synthesis, structured KIE, document, and table synthesis, and reasoning-oriented annotation synthesis. Each pipeline incorporates dedicated generation and verification procedures to ensure visual-text consistency, structural validity, and task-specific supervision quality.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,发动机将原始视觉资源与特定任务的监督生成脱钩。 各种来源,包括街道图像、文件模板、年度报告、书籍、PDF、表格和经核实的OCR说明,被转化为现场文字理解、双语翻译、关键信息提取、文档解析、表格理解和OCR中心推理的监督。 发动机被组织成三个互补的合成管道:场景文本和翻译合成,结构化的KIE,文档,和表合成,以及以推理为导向的注释合成. 每个管道都包含专门的生成和核查程序,以确保视觉文本的一致性、结构有效性和具体任务的监督质量。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of the targeted data-construction engine. Heterogeneous raw assets are transformed into task-specific supervision for scene-text detection and recognition, bilingual translation, key information extraction, document parsing, Chinese table localization and parsing, and OCR-centric reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图3:目标数据构建引擎概况. 异质原始资产被转化为任务特定监督,用于现场文本检测和识别,双语翻译,关键信息提取,文档解析,中表本地化和解析,以及OCR中心推理.

blocks.en: Rendering text into natural backgrounds provides paired localization and recognition supervision, as demonstrated by SynthText ( Gupta et al., 2016 ) . We construct scene-text supervision from both real-world images and controllable synthesis. For text-containing natural images, PP-OCRv6 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and LocateAnything ( Wang et al., 2026b ) are employed as independent annotators for text localization and recognition. Their predictions are cross-validated through spatial overlap and transcription consistency, and only mutually verified instances are retained as localization, recognition, and spotting supervision. Samples exhibiting substantial disagreement are identified as hard cases and further annotated by human annotators before being incorporated into the training corpus. For images without visible text, a synthetic branch renders text onto realistic background regions while controlling language, font, character size, orientation, color, contrast, perspective distortion, blur, and compression artifacts. The rendered transcriptions and spatial annotations are further verified for visual-text consistency before being added to the training set. This dual-source construction strategy provides both naturally occurring scene-text diversity and controllable localization-recognition supervision.
blocks.zh: 将文本引入自然背景可提供对称本地化和识别监督,如SynthText(Gupta等人,2016年)所证明的. 我们从真实世界的图像 和可控制的合成中 构建了场景文字监督 对于含有文本的自然图像,PP-OCRv6(Zhang等人,2026a)和LocAnything(Wang等人,2026b)被用作文本本地化和识别的独立注释者。 他们的预测通过空间重叠和抄录一致性进行交叉验证,只有相互核实的事例才被保留作为本地化,识别和定点监督. 表现出重大分歧的样本被确定为棘手案件,并在编入培训书之前由人名注释员作进一步说明。 对于没有可见文本的图像,一个合成分支在控制语言,字体,字符大小,方向,颜色,对比,视角扭曲,模糊,压缩文物的同时,使文本进入现实背景区域. 提供的文字记录和空间说明在编入培训内容之前,将进一步核实视觉文本的一致性。 这种双源建筑战略既提供自然发生的场景文字多样性,又提供可控制的本地化识别监督.

blocks.en: We construct spatially grounded translation supervision from scene images with verified text regions and transcriptions. For each text instance, Qwen3.5-9B generates both Chinese–English and English–Chinese translations. The generated translations are filtered using language consistency, numerical and symbol preservation, named-entity consistency, repetition detection, and length constraints. Each sample contains the original image, a region-aware translation instruction, and the corresponding translation. This construction enables the model to jointly learn text localization, recognition, and multilingual transformation while maintaining the spatial grounding of the source text.
blocks.zh: 我们从现场图像中构建空间化的翻译监督,并附有经核实的文本区和抄录。 每个文本实例,Quen3.5-9B同时生成中文(英语)和英文(英语)的中文翻译. 生成的译文采用语言一致性,数字和符号保存,命名实体一致性,重复检测和长度限制等方式过滤. 每个样本包含原始图像,一个区域感知翻译指令,以及相应的翻译. 这种构建使模型能够共同学习文本本地化,识别,以及多语种转换,同时保持源文本的空间定位.

blocks.en: Recent KIE synthesis frameworks such as SAYRE use document exemplars and editable HTML representations to generate new images with aligned field annotations ( Xu et al., 2026b ) . We develop a template-preserving synthesis pipeline for structured documents, including forms, receipts, certificates, labels, and other field-oriented images. A vision-language model first reconstructs each document into an editable HTML/CSS representation. A language model then replaces the original key–value contents while preserving field semantics and layout constraints. The modified templates are subsequently rendered into new document images with naturally aligned annotations. Generated samples are filtered for text overflow, abnormal line wrapping, element overlap, missing fonts, field inconsistency, and severe visual distortion. This pipeline expands the semantic and visual diversity of KIE supervision while preserving accurate key–value alignment.
blocks.zh: 最近的 KIE 合成框架,如 SayRE 使用文档示例和可编辑的 HTML 表达式生成新图像,并配对字段说明(Xu et al., 2026b ). 我们为结构化的文件开发一个模板保存合成管道,包括表格、收据、证书、标签和其他面向实地的图像。 一个视觉语言模型首先将每个文档重建为可编辑的HTML/CSS代表. 然后,一个语言模型在保留字段语义和布局限制的同时,替换原始的密钥-值内容. 修改后的模板随后被制成带有自然对齐说明的新文档图像. 生成的样本被过滤为文本溢出,线条包装异常,元素重叠,字体缺失,字段不一致,以及严重的视觉扭曲. 这一管道扩展了KIE监管的语义和视觉多样性,同时保持了准确的密钥-值对齐.

blocks.en: To enrich document-level supervision, we collect a diverse corpus of PDF documents, including academic papers, annual reports, research reports, books, and documents containing handwritten content, and render their pages as images. To promote page diversity, we first extract page features using a visual encoder and apply k-means clustering to group pages with similar visual characteristics. In parallel, we use PP-DocLayoutV3 to detect layout elements and compute a page complexity score based on their counts and predefined category weights, assigning higher weights to complex, less frequent element types, such as figures and charts, and lower weights to common, simpler elements, such as regular text. Within each cluster, we stratify pages by their complexity scores and sample uniformly across strata, ensuring coverage of diverse visual characteristics and complexity levels.We then independently parse the sampled pages using PaddleOCR-VL and MinerU2.5-Pro to produce document annotations in reading order ( Cui et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . We compare the outputs of the two models and use their similarity as a proxy for annotation quality. Annotations for pages with high inter-model agreement are retained as high-quality candidates. For pages with low agreement, we use Qwen-3.5 to identify and correct omissions, recognition errors, and structural discrepancies, taking both parsing outputs and the original page image as input. The resulting annotations are consolidated into Markdown and plain-text formats. Markdown annotations preserve document hierarchy and content elements, including paragraphs, headings, notes, lists, tables, and formulas, while plain-text annotations support full-page transcription tasks. All annotations undergo rule-based cleaning and normalization, including LaTeX standardization for formulas, HTML normalization for tables, removal of unsupported tags and placeholders, elimination of malformed structures, and deduplication.
blocks.zh: 为了丰富文件层面的监督,我们收集了各种PDF文件,包括学术论文、年度报告、研究报告、书籍和载有手写内容的文件,并把它们的网页制作成图像。 为促进页面多样性,我们首先使用视觉编码器提取页面功能,并将k-意为集群应用于具有类似视觉特征的分组页面. 同时,我们使用PP-DocLayoutV3来检测布局元素,并根据它们的计数和预定义的类别权重计算一个页面复杂度分,将更高的权重分配给复杂,较少的元素类型,如数字和图表,将权重降低到普通,更简单的元素,如正则文本. 在每一组中,我们用其复杂性分数和不同阶层的样本来划分网页,确保涵盖不同的视觉特征和复杂程度。 然后,我们用PaddleOCR-VL和MinerU2.5-Pro对样本页进行独立解析,按阅读顺序编制文件说明(Cui等人,2025b;Cui等人,2025a); 王等, 2026a ). 我们比较了两种模型的输出结果,并将其相似性用作注释质量的代名词. 具有高模范协议的网页说明作为高质量候选人保留。 对于协议较低的页面,我们使用Quen-3.5来识别和纠正遗漏,识别错误,以及结构差异,同时将解析输出和原始页面图像作为输入. 由此产生的说明被合并为Markdown和纯文本格式. Markdown说明保存文档的层次和内容要素,包括段落,标题,注释,列表,表格和公式,而纯文本说明则支持全页的抄写任务. 所有说明都经过基于规则的清理和正常化,包括公式的LaTeX标准化,表的HTML正常化,去除不支持的标记和占位符,消除结构不整齐,以及复制.

blocks.en: Existing datasets for table understanding primarily focus on table structure recognition, offering limited support for joint table localization and parsing within full-page documents. To address this limitation, we construct a full-page table understanding dataset covering diverse visual styles and levels of structural complexity. We first detect tables in document pages and classify them as fully bordered, borderless, or partially bordered using a table classification model. Each table is then independently parsed by PaddleOCR-VL and MinerU2.5-Pro ( Cui et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , and their outputs are normalized into HTML. We compute the TEDS score between the corresponding outputs to assess inter-model consistency as a reference for annotation quality. Annotations with high consistency are accepted as candidates, while those with lower consistency are refined by Qwen-3.5 using the original page image and both models’ outputs. To preserve annotation completeness, we retain a page only after all its tables have been annotated and passed the quality checks, discarding pages with unresolved omissions or severe annotation errors. From the resulting HTML annotations, we extract row and column counts, the number and proportion of merged cells, and their row and column spans to characterize table size and structural complexity. We use these attributes together with the visual style categories for stratified sampling, followed by manual spot checks to promote data diversity and annotation quality. Each sample comprises a full-page document image, table bounding boxes, and HTML annotations, supporting joint table localization and structure parsing.
blocks.zh: 用于表理解的现有数据集主要侧重于表结构识别,为联合表本地化提供有限的支持,并在全页文档中解析. 为了解决这一局限性,我们构建了一个全页表格,理解涵盖各种视觉风格和结构复杂程度的数据集。 我们首先在文档页中检测表格,并使用表格分类模型将其归类为完全边框、无边框或部分边框。 然后由PaddleOCR-VL和MinerU2.5-Pro(Cui等人,2025年b;Cui等人,2025年a;Wang等人,2026年a)独立解析各表,其产出正常化为HTML. 我们计算相应的产出之间的TEDS分数,以评估模型间的一致性,作为注释质量的参考。 具有高度一致性的说明被接受为候选人,而具有较低一致性的说明则由Quen-3.5使用原始页面图像和两种模型的产出加以改进。 为了保持注释的完整性,我们只保留一个页,直到其所有表格都作了注释和通过了质量检查,丢弃了有未解决的遗漏或严重注释错误的页。 从所产生的HTML说明中,我们提取行数和列数,合并单元格的数量和比例,以及其行和列的跨度,以描述表格大小和结构复杂性。 我们使用这些属性和视觉风格分类进行分层抽样,然后进行人工抽查,以促进数据多样性和注释质量。 每个样本包括全页文档图像,表格绑定框,以及HTML说明,支持联合表格本地化和结构解析.

blocks.en: To provide reliable supervision for OCR-related quantitative reasoning, we construct counting tasks from quality-verified text recognition and localization annotations using deterministic templates. Text annotations are normalized with respect to character encoding, whitespace, punctuation, and full-width or half-width symbols while preserving character case and visual semantics. Based on these annotations, we automatically generate diverse counting instructions and reasoning traces, including character-level counting and text-instance counting. The generated samples inherit exact answers from verified OCR annotations, providing consistent supervision for OCR-centric numerical reasoning without introducing noise from model-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 为了对与OCR相关的定量推理提供可靠的监督,我们用确定性模板从质量验证的文本识别和本地化说明中构建计数任务. 文本注释在字符编码,白空,平移,以及全宽或半宽符号方面实现正常化,同时保留字符大小写和视觉语义. 基于这些说明,我们自动生成不同的计数指令和推理痕迹,包括字符级计数和文本提示计数. 生成的样本继承了经核实的OCR说明中准确的答案,为OCR中心数字推理提供一致的监督,而不引入模型生成的标签中的噪声.

blocks.en: For complex reasoning tasks that cannot be efficiently generated through deterministic rules, we employ strong reasoning models, represented by DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , to construct candidate questions, explanations, and answers based on verified OCR and structured annotations. The generated examples cover textual content understanding, document field reasoning, key–value relationships, table interpretation, spatial reasoning, and other OCR-centric capabilities. The source annotations are used only for generation guidance and verification. Candidate samples are validated through task-specific consistency checks, and examples containing incorrect answers, unsupported reasoning steps, or invalid output formats are removed.
blocks.zh: 对于无法通过定型规则有效产生的复杂推理任务,我们采用以DeepSeek-V4-Pro(徐等人,2026a)为代表的强推理模型,根据经过核实的OCR和结构化说明构建候选问题,解释和答案. 生成的例子包括文本内容理解、文档字段推理、关键值关系、表格解释、空间推理和其他OCR中心能力。 源说明仅用于生成指导和验证. 通过任务特定的一致性检查验证候选样本,并删除包含错误答案,不支持推理步骤,或无效输出格式的例子.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-Pipeline Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.3 跨管道质量控制

blocks.en: Across the construction pipelines, quality control uses three complementary forms of verification. First, agreement-based validation compares independent annotations when multiple recognizers or parsers are available, retaining mutually consistent predictions and sending selected scene-text disagreements for human adjudication. Second, structure-aware validation checks whether generated coordinates, HTML, Markdown, formulas, and key–value records remain well formed and consistent with the rendered image. This includes detecting element overlap, text overflow, malformed table structures, missing fields, unsupported tags, and content loss. Third, source-grounded validation checks whether generated translations, questions, reasoning traces, and answers preserve the textual or structured evidence available in the source annotations. Samples that fail the corresponding checks are removed rather than repaired through unconstrained generation.
blocks.zh: 在整个施工管道中,质量控制采用三种补充形式的核查。 首先,在有多个识别器或解析器时,基于协议的验证比较了独立的说明,保留了相互一致的预测,并将选定的场景文本分歧发送给人类裁决. 第二,了解结构的验证检查是否生成坐标、HTML、Markdown、公式和密钥-值记录仍然形成良好,是否与成像一致。 这包括检测元素重叠,文本溢出,表格结构不整齐,缺失字段,不支持标记,以及内容丢失. 第三,基于源的验证检查是否生成了翻译,提问,推理痕迹,以及答案,保留了源说明中可用的文字或结构化证据. 未能通过相应检查的样本被移除,而不是通过不受限制的生成修复.

blocks.en: These validation signals also expose difficult examples. In particular, cross-model disagreements that are resolved through human annotation provide quality-verified hard scene-text cases, while valid samples with challenging structured outputs are retained only after passing task-specific format and consistency checks. During training, such hard examples are mixed with broader coverage data without being allowed to dominate the task distribution. After capability balancing and sampling, the resulting corpus delivers approximately 60 million high-quality OCR training instances, achieving broad coverage across diverse scenarios, tasks, and supervision formats to support model training.
blocks.zh: 这些验证信号也暴露了困难的例子. 特别是,通过人类注释解决的跨模型分歧提供了经过质量验证的硬场景文本案例,而具有挑战性结构化产出的有效样本只有在通过特定任务格式和一致性检查后才能保留。 在培训期间,这种硬例子与更广泛的覆盖面数据混杂在一起,不允许主导任务分配。 在进行能力平衡和取样后,培训机构提供了大约6 000万个高质量的业务记录和记录培训实例,在各种情景、任务和监督形式中广泛涵盖,以支持示范培训。

blocks.en: 4 Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训管道

blocks.en: Training a unified OCR foundation model is challenging due to the highly heterogeneous nature of OCR tasks, where different capabilities exhibit distinct learning difficulties, optimization objectives, and competence boundaries. A model may achieve strong performance on common recognition patterns while still struggling with complex document structures, long-tail scenarios, or reasoning-intensive OCR tasks.
blocks.zh: 培训一个统一的OCR基金会模式具有挑战性,因为OCR任务性质迥异,不同的能力显示出不同的学习困难、优化目标和能力界限。 一个模型可能在共同识别模式上实现强效,同时仍然与复杂的文件结构,长尾假想,或推理密集型的OCR任务挣扎.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we develop a two-stage training framework consisting of capability acquisition and competence-guided refinement. The first stage adopts supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to establish broad OCR capabilities across heterogeneous tasks, including text recognition and localization, document parsing, table understanding, key information extraction, multilingual transformation, and OCR-centric visual question answering. The second stage introduces Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO), which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with adaptive on-policy distillation (OPD) to dynamically allocate optimization signals according to the competence relationship between the teacher and student models.
blocks.zh: 为应对这一挑战,我们制定了两阶段培训框架,包括能力获取和能力指导改进。 第一阶段采用有监督的微调(SFT),以便在各种任务中建立广泛的OCR能力,包括文本识别和本地化、文件解析、表格理解、关键信息提取、多语种转换和以OCR为中心的视觉问题回答。 第二阶段引入了能力导向政策优化(CGPO),将基于核查者的团体相对政策优化(GRPO)与适应性政策提炼(OPD)相结合,根据师生模式的能力关系动态分配优化信号.

blocks.en: Both model variants use the same SFT and CGPO training settings. The CGPO stage uses a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} , with Qwen3.5-122B-A10B serving as the teacher for offline competence estimation and token-level OPD.
blocks.zh: 两个模型变体都使用相同的SFT和CGPO训练设置. CGPO阶段采用10−6 10^{-6}的学习率,由Quen3.5-122B-A10B担任离线能力估计和符号级OPD的教师.

Stage I applies a three-phase curriculum SFT schedule over Text Perception (TP), Document Structure Understanding (DS), OCR Understanding and Reasoning (OR), and General Multimodal Alignment (GA) data. Stage II performs CGPO by combining verifier-driven GRPO with conditional OPD. blocks.en: 4.2 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.2 监督的微调

blocks.en: The SFT corpus contains task families that differ substantially in data volume, output structure, and learning difficulty. Sampling them in their raw proportions would overrepresent the largest sources and provide limited control over the contribution of each capability. We therefore partition the corpus into four groups and assign their sampling quotas explicitly. Text Perception (TP) covers text recognition, grounding, position-aware VQA, and text spotting. Document Structure Understanding (DS) includes key-information extraction and mapping, handwritten answer extraction, document, chart, and table parsing, and formula recognition. OCR Understanding and Reasoning (OR) comprises classification, translation, counting, mathematical question answering, and other OCR-grounded reasoning tasks. General Multimodal Alignment (GA) retains broad image understanding and instruction-following data.
blocks.zh: 《SFT套案》包含了在数据量、产出结构和学习困难方面差异很大的任务家族。 对它们进行原始抽样将过度成为最大的来源,对每种能力的贡献的控制有限。 因此,我们把调查对象分为四组,并明确分配其抽样配额。 文本感知(TP)涵盖文本识别,地面定位,位置感知VQA,以及文本显示. 文档结构理解(DS)包括密钥信息提取和映射,手写答案提取,文档,图表,和表格解析,以及公式识别. OCR理解和理性(OR)包括分类,翻译,计数,数学问答,以及其他OCR基于推理的任务. 一般多式联运对齐(GA)保留了广义的图像理解和跟随指令的数据.

blocks.en: Across the approximately 60 million SFT instances, TP, DS, OR, and GA account for 32.5 % 32.5\% , 30.0 % 30.0\% , 22.5 % 22.5\% , and 15.0 % 15.0\% , respectively. This allocation gives most of the optimization budget to text perception and document structure, while retaining dedicated coverage for OCR-grounded semantics, reasoning, and general multimodal behavior.
blocks.zh: 在大约6 000万个SFT案例中,TP、DS、OR和GA分别占32.5%、32.5%、30.0%、22.5%、15.0%。 这种分配使大部分优化预算用于文本感知和文档结构,同时保留了OCR基于语义的专用覆盖,推理,以及一般的多式联运行为.

blocks.en: Table 2: Three-phase sampling schedule for SFT. Percentages denote the within-phase proportions of the four data groups.
blocks.zh: 表2:SFT的三阶段取样时间表。 百分比表示四个数据组在阶段内的比例。

blocks.en: We apply a three-phase quota schedule, with each phase containing 20 million instances. The early phase places greater weight on TP and DS. The OR share then increases from 10.0 % 10.0\% to 35.0 % 35.0\% as training progresses, whereas GA remains fixed at 15.0 % 15.0\% . Each group is sampled without replacement according to its phase-specific quota, and the selected instances are shuffled within each phase. Consequently, the complete schedule traverses the full SFT corpus while preserving the overall mixture shown in Table 2 . The resulting checkpoint initializes the subsequent CGPO stage.

blocks.en: 4.3 Competence-Guided Policy Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.3 能力指导政策优化

blocks.en: The SFT stage establishes broad OCR competence, but its imitation objective does not directly optimize verifier-defined task outcomes. We therefore use outcome-supervised Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns each response a scalar reward and derives token advantages from its relative reward within a rollout group ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Our ablation in Table 9 reports a CC-OCR score of 81.72 81.72 for GRPO and 82.18 82.18 after adding fixed-weight OPD, supporting the use of complementary supervision.
blocks.zh: SFT阶段确立了广泛的OCR权限,但其模仿目标并没有直接优化核查者定义的任务结果. 因此,我们使用成果监督小组的相对政策优化(GRPO),它为每个答复分配了分级奖励,并从推出小组的相对奖励中获得象征性好处(Shao等人,2024年)。 在表9中,我们报告的CC-OCR的GRPO成绩为81.72.72分,加上固定重量的OPD之后的82.18 82.18分,支持使用补充监督.

blocks.en: Consider an illustrative long-text OCR case: a financial document contains 1,000 characters after normalization, including the amount 18,650 . Suppose the eight student rollouts preserve the surrounding text but transcribe this amount as 18,850 or 18,350 . Each output contains one character substitution, so normalized edit similarity assigns all eight responses the same reward, 1 − 1 / 1000 = 0.999 1-1/1000=0.999 . The amount is incorrect despite the high page-level score. With A i = ( r i − r ¯ ) / ( std ⁡ ( r ) + ϵ ) A_{i}=(r_{i}-\bar{r})/(\operatorname{std}(r)+\epsilon) , all group-relative advantages are zero, and this group contributes no reward-driven policy gradient to correct the digit. This equal-reward degeneracy is also discussed in DAPO ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . Even when rewards differ, the response-level advantage does not identify the erroneous position.

DAPO(Yu等人,2025年)也讨论了这种同等报酬的变性。 即使奖励不同,反应层面的优势也无法识别错误位置.

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level supervision by evaluating the teacher on student-generated prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . In the example, a teacher distribution that favors the correct continuation when the amount is generated provides information that the tied outcome rewards cannot supply. However, this supervision inherits the teacher’s errors: if the teacher favors 18,850 , distillation can reinforce the same incorrect digit. If the student later recognizes 18,650 correctly while the teacher still favors the wrong continuation, a fixed OPD weight can oppose the correction encouraged by the verifier. Teacher fluency and a high page-level score therefore do not establish the usefulness of its local guidance.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)通过对教师进行学生产生的前缀评估,提供密集的标志级监督(Agarwal等人,2024年)。 举例来说,在产生金额时倾向于正确延续的教师分配提供了附带条件的结果奖励无法提供的信息。 然而,这种监督继承了老师的错误:如果老师偏爱18,850,蒸馏可以强化同样的不正确的数字. 如果学生后来在老师仍然倾向于错误的续作的同时正确认出18,650,固定的OPD权重可以反对校验者鼓励的校正. 因此,教师的流利度和高水平的分数并不能确定当地指导的效用。

blocks.en: We propose Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO) to retain GRPO as the optimization backbone and condition the OPD weight on both teacher quality and the teacher’s advantage over the current student. Reliable teacher advantages warrant stronger distillation; unreliable guidance or a diminishing advantage warrants less. This sample-wise allocation preserves verifier-guided exploration as student competence changes.
blocks.zh: 我们提议以能力指导政策优化(CGPO)保留GRPO作为最优化的骨干,并将OPD的权重限制在师资质量和师资优势之上。 可靠的教师优势需要更强的蒸馏;不可靠的指导或不断降低的优势需要更少。 这种抽样分配保留了核实者指导的探索,因为学生的能力在变化。

blocks.en: For each training sample x x from task family τ \tau , let y ⋆ y^{\star} denote its quality-verified reference. A task-specific verifier assigns an outcome reward R τ ​ ( x , y , y ⋆ ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] R_{\tau}(x,y,y^{\star})\in[0,1] . The verifier is instantiated according to the semantic structure of each task, using normalized edit similarity for text recognition, intersection-over-union (IoU) for visual grounding, character detection matching (CDM) for formula recognition ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , tree-edit-distance-based similarity (TEDS) for table parsing ( Zhong et al., 2020 ) , field-level F1 for key information extraction, and an LLM-based correctness judge for open-ended OCR-centric VQA. Task-specific rewards also underpin multi-task OCR reinforcement learning in Infinity-Parser2 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , while criterion-based language-model assessment has been studied in G-Eval ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . Our task-specific metrics are mapped to a common reward space and supplied to GRPO for outcome-based policy optimization. The same verified reference and verifier are used to score teacher and student generations.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation of PolyOCR across diverse text-centric visual intelligence scenarios. The evaluation examines the model’s ability to generalize beyond isolated OCR tasks, covering text perception, spatially grounded understanding, structured document analysis, information extraction, and OCR-oriented reasoning. We further investigate the effectiveness of the proposed Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO) framework.
blocks.zh: 我们通过各种以文字为中心的视觉智能情景,对PolyOCR进行全面的经验性评价。 评估研究了该模型在孤立的OCR任务之外概括性的能力,涵盖文本感知,基于空间的理解,结构化的文件分析,信息提取,以及面向OCR的推理. 我们进一步调查拟议的“能力指导政策优化”框架的有效性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: We establish a unified evaluation protocol to assess PolyOCR across diverse OCR and document intelligence scenarios. All compared models are evaluated under consistent benchmark versions, inference configurations, and scoring procedures to ensure reliable and reproducible comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了统一的评估协议,以在各种OCR和文件情报设想中评估PolyOCR。 所有比较模型都根据一致的基准版本、推论配置和评分程序进行评估,以确保可靠和可复制的比较。

blocks.en: We evaluate two model variants, PolyOCR-2B and PolyOCR-9B. Both variants adopt the Qwen3.5 vision-language backbone and are trained under the unified OCR training framework described in Sections 3 and 4 . Unless otherwise specified, all evaluations are conducted under the same inference configuration, including prompt templates, image preprocessing strategies, visual token budgets, and decoding settings. Additionally, we include PolyOCR-2.7B in the MDPBench evaluation to assess multilingual document parsing capabilities. This variant features a specialized architecture comprising a 1.2B-parameter ViT vision encoder and a 1.5B-parameter Qwen2.5 text decoder, optimized for diverse writing systems and acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个模型变体PolyOCR-2B和PolyOCR-9B. 两个变体采用Quen3.5视觉语言主干线,并在第3和第4节所述统一OCR培训框架下接受培训。 除非另有说明,所有评价都是在相同的推论配置下进行的,包括即时模板,图像预处理策略,视觉符号预算和解码设置. 此外,我们还将PolyOCR-2.7B列入MDP Bench评价,以评估多语种文件解析能力。 这个变体的特色是一个专门的建筑,包括一个1.2B参数的ViT视觉编码器和一个1.5B参数的Quen2.5文本解码器,优化后用于多种书写系统和获取条件.

blocks.en: We refine the original OCRBench v2 evaluation protocol to improve the reliability, consistency, and discriminative capability of benchmark evaluation. Due to the limited quality of some original reference annotations and the insufficient alignment between certain evaluation metrics and the actual task objectives, we revise two key aspects of the protocol: reference annotation quality and task-specific evaluation criteria. Specifically, reference annotations are systematically audited and corrected to reduce annotation noise, while task-specific evaluation procedures are refined to better align scoring mechanisms with the semantic objectives of individual tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们完善了最初的OCR Bench v2评价协议,以提高基准评价的可靠性,一致性和歧视性能力. 由于一些原始参考说明的质量有限,而且某些评价衡量标准与实际任务目标之间不够一致,我们修改了议定书的两个关键方面:参考说明质量和具体任务评价标准。 具体而言,参考说明经过系统审计和纠正,以减少注释噪声,而针对具体任务的评价程序则得到完善,以便更好地使评分机制与个别任务的语义目标保持一致。

blocks.en: The resulting OCRBench v2.1 protocol preserves the original task coverage while providing more reliable annotations and more task-aligned evaluation criteria. Detailed modifications to annotations, metrics, and evaluation procedures are presented in Appendix 11 . All OCRBench v2.1 results reported in this work are obtained using the refined evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的OCR Bench v2.1协议保留了最初的任务覆盖范围,同时提供了更可靠的说明和更符合任务的评价标准. 对说明、衡量标准和评价程序的详细修改载于附录11。 这项工作中报告的所有OCR Bench v2.1成果都是利用完善的评价协议取得的。

blocks.en: The evaluation suite consists of five representative benchmarks: OCRBench v2.1 (our revision of OCRBench v2 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ), CC-OCR ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , OmniDocBench v1.6 ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , MDPBench ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and an in-house KIE benchmark. OCRBench v2.1 and CC-OCR provide comprehensive evaluations across diverse OCR scenarios, covering broad text-centric visual capabilities. OmniDocBench v1.6 evaluates document-centric parsing ability, including layout analysis, table understanding, formula recognition, and document-level content reconstruction. MDPBench further extends the evaluation to multilingual document parsing, covering diverse language/script groups and both digital and photographed documents. The in-house KIE benchmark evaluates the model’s ability to extract structured information from document images, focusing on field-level information extraction under practical application scenarios.
blocks.zh: 评估套装包括五个代表性基准:OCR Bench v2.1(我们修订OCR Bench v2(Fu等人,2025年)),CC-OCR(Yang等人,2025年),OmniDoc Bench v1.6(Ouyang等人,2025年),MDP Bench(Li等人,2026年b),以及内部的KIE基准. OCR Bench v2.1和CC-OCR提供各种OCR情景的综合评价,涵盖广泛的文本中心视觉能力. OmniDoc Bench v1.6评价以文档为中心的解析能力,包括布局分析,表格理解,公式识别,以及文档级别的内容重建. MDP Bench进一步将评价扩大到多语种文件解析,涵盖多种语言/文字组以及数字和照片文件。 内部的KIE基准评价模型从文件图像中提取结构化信息的能力,重点是在实际应用情景下实地一级的信息提取.

blocks.en: We compare PolyOCR against a diverse set of representative vision-language models, including both general-purpose and OCR-specialized models with different scales and architectural designs. For public benchmarks, we use their official test sets and retain the corresponding evaluation protocols for CC-OCR, OmniDocBench v1.6, and MDPBench. For OCRBench v2.1, all comparisons are conducted using the refined annotations and scoring procedures introduced above; therefore, scores obtained under the original OCRBench v2 protocol are not directly comparable. For the in-house KIE benchmark, we evaluate models using the same test set and field-level F1 metric to ensure consistent comparison across different systems.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了PolyOCR与一组具有代表性的视觉语言模型,包括具有不同尺度和建筑设计的通用模型和OCR专业模型. 对于公共基准,我们使用他们的官方测试集,并保留CC-OCR,OmniDoc Bench v1.6和MDP Bench的相应评价协议. 对于OCR Bench v2.1,所有比较都使用上文引入的精细说明和评分程序进行;因此,根据最初OCR Bench v2协议获得的分数并不直接可比. 对于内部的KIE基准,我们使用相同的测试集和外地F1度量度来评价模型,以确保不同系统之间的一致比较.

blocks.en: 5.2 Overall Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.2 总比较

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the cross-benchmark performance of PolyOCR against representative general-purpose vision-language models and OCR-specialized systems. The evaluated benchmarks collectively assess a broad spectrum of text-centric visual capabilities, including fundamental text perception, document-level structural understanding, and OCR-oriented semantic reasoning. PolyOCR-9B demonstrates competitive and consistent performance across all evaluated benchmarks. It achieves scores of 80.42 and 78.37 on the English and Chinese settings of OCRBench v2.1, respectively, and obtains a score of 82.43 on CC-OCR. Furthermore, PolyOCR-9B reaches 91.57 on OmniDocBench v1.6, demonstrating its capability to extend from fine-grained text recognition toward complex document structure understanding and parsing.
blocks.zh: 表3总结了PolyOCR对照具有代表性的通用视觉语言模型和OCR专用系统的跨基准性能. 评估的基准集体评估了以文字为中心的广泛视觉能力,包括基本文本感知、文件层次的结构理解和面向OCR的语义推理。 PolyOCR-9B在所有评价基准中都表现出竞争力和一致性。 它在OCR Bench v2.1的英语和中文设置上分别取得了80.42分和78.37分的成绩,并在CC-OCR上获得了82.43分的成绩. 此外,PolyOCR-9B在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上达到91.57,表明它有能力从精细文字识别延伸到复杂的文件结构理解和解析。

blocks.en: The cross-benchmark evaluation demonstrates that the proposed model maintains robust performance across heterogeneous OCR scenarios and task formulations. Such capability consistency reflects the effectiveness of the unified training paradigm in developing a general-purpose OCR foundation model with broad text-centric visual understanding abilities. Its competitive performance across diverse task settings, including text transcription, spatial localization, structured document parsing, and semantic reasoning, highlights the model’s ability to address varied OCR requirements while maintaining balanced capabilities across different levels of text-centric visual intelligence. The following sections further analyze the model performance on individual benchmarks and provide detailed comparisons across different OCR capabilities.
blocks.zh: 跨基准评价表明,拟议模式保持了不同业务记录制度设想和任务拟定的强劲业绩。 这种能力一致性反映了统一培训模式在开发具有广泛的文字中心视觉理解能力的通用OCR基础模型方面的效力。 它在不同的任务环境,包括文本转录、空间定位、结构化文件解析和语义推理的竞争性表现,突出了模型在保持以文本为中心的不同视觉智能水平的平衡能力的同时,解决各种OCR要求的能力。 以下各节进一步分析了单个基准的模型性能,并提供了不同OCR能力的详细比较.

blocks.zh: 5.3 OCR Bench v2.1 评价

blocks.en: OCRBench v2.1 provides a comprehensive evaluation of text-centric visual intelligence across diverse OCR capabilities, including text recognition, localization, spotting, document parsing, formula understanding, translation, and OCR-oriented reasoning. Table 4 presents a detailed comparison across these capability categories, providing a fine-grained assessment of model performance beyond overall accuracy.
blocks.zh: OCR Bench v2.1提供了对各种OCR能力以文字为中心的视觉智能的全面评价,包括文本识别,本地化,抽查,文档解析,公式理解,翻译,以及面向OCR的推理. 表4详细比较了这些能力类别,对超出总体准确度的模型性能进行了精细评估。

blocks.en: PolyOCR-9B achieves competitive performance on OCRBench v2.1, obtaining overall scores of 80.42 and 78.37 on the English and Chinese settings, respectively. The model demonstrates strong results across text perception, document understanding, and OCR-oriented reasoning. These results indicate that the proposed unified training framework effectively enables the model to handle heterogeneous OCR tasks within a single generative modeling paradigm.
blocks.zh: PolyOCR-9B在OCR Bench v2.1上实现竞技性能,在英语和中文设置上分别获得80.42分和78.37分的总分. 该模型显示在文本感知、文件理解和面向OCR的推理方面都取得了强有力的成果。 这些结果表明,拟议的统一培训框架有效地使模型能够在单一的基因模型模式中处理各种OCR任务。

blocks.en: At the category level, PolyOCR-9B ranks first among the compared models in five of the 13 language-specific categories: English text recognition ( 82.99 82.99 ), text detection ( 70.84 70.84 ), element parsing ( 89.70 89.70 ), and visual text understanding ( 87.58 87.58 ), together with Chinese element parsing ( 86.86 86.86 ). It ranks second in English text spotting ( 78.50 78.50 ) and English relationship extraction ( 95.51 95.51 ). These results show strengths in text perception and structured parsing, while mathematical calculation, Chinese text recognition, and Chinese visual text understanding remain below the strongest evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh: 在类别一级,PolyOCR-9B在13个语言特定类别中的5个类别中的比较模型中排名第一: 英文文本识别(82.99 82.99),文本检测(70.84 70.84),元素解析(89.70 89.70),视觉文本理解(87.58 87.58),连同中文元素解析(86.86 86.86). 它在英语文本抽查(78.50 78.50)和英语关系提取(95.51 95.51. 这些结果显示文本感知和结构解析的优势,而数学计算,中文文本识别,以及中文视觉文本理解仍然低于最强的评价基线.

blocks.en: Overall, the OCRBench v2.1 results demonstrate that PolyOCR provides a balanced and comprehensive OCR capability across heterogeneous task formulations, establishing a strong foundation for unified text-centric visual intelligence.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,OCR Bench v2.1的结果表明,PolyOCR为不同任务配方提供了平衡和全面的OCR能力,为统一的文本中心视觉智能奠定了坚实的基础.

blocks.en: 5.5 OmniDocBench v1.6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.5 奥姆尼道克奔驰 v1.6 评价

blocks.en:
OmniDocBench v1.6 targets document parsing within complex page layouts, focusing on the evaluation of capabilities such as text recognition, formula recognition, and table parsing. Table 6 summarizes PolyOCR’s performance across various document components and reading orders.
When processing full pages directly, PolyOCR achieved a composite score of 91.57 , demonstrating strong competitiveness compared to general-purpose vision-language models. This indicates that the recognition capabilities acquired through unified OCR training can be applied to page-level document parsing, enabling the model to extract diverse types of document content from complex layouts.

OmniDoc Bench v1.6 目标文档在复杂的页面布局中解析,侧重于文本识别,公式识别,表解等能力的评价. 表6概述了PolyOCR在各种文件组成部分和阅读订单方面的业绩。
在直接处理整页时,PolyOCR取得了91.57的复合分数,与通用视觉语言模型相比表现出了强大的竞争力. 这表明,通过统一OCR培训获得的识别能力可以应用于页面级文档解析,使模型能够从复杂的布局中提取不同类型的文档内容.

blocks.en: To further examine PolyOCR’s parsing capabilities regarding various document components, we introduced a layout-guided pipeline setup. This configuration utilizes PP-DocLayoutV3 to detect layout elements and predict reading order; the same PolyOCR model then parses the cropped regions containing texts, formulas, and tables, and the results are finally assembled into a Markdown document based on the predicted reading order. By delegating page layout analysis to an external module, this setup allows PolyOCR to focus more effectively on content recognition and structural recovery within the specific regions.

blocks.en: Under this configuration, the composite score rose from 91.57 to 95.52 , with improvements observed across all reported metrics. These results further validate PolyOCR’s effectiveness as a unified document component parser capable of handling texts, formulas, and tables with a single model. When combined with a layout analysis module, PolyOCR achieves page-level parsing performance comparable to leading specialized systems.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This report presents PolyOCR, a unified OCR foundation model that advances OCR from isolated text recognition toward comprehensive text-centric visual intelligence. By integrating capability-oriented data construction with competence-aware post-training, PolyOCR establishes a unified modeling paradigm for diverse OCR scenarios, encompassing scene text understanding, document parsing, information extraction, structured content recovery, multilingual transformation, and OCR-oriented reasoning.
blocks.zh: 本报告介绍了PolyOCR,一种统一的OCR基础模型,将OCR从孤立的文本识别推进到全面的以文本为中心的视觉智能. PolyOCR通过将面向能力的数据构建与能力认知后培训相结合,为各种OCR情景建立统一的模型模型,包括场景文本理解,文档解析,信息提取,结构化内容恢复,多语种转换,以及面向OCR的推理.

blocks.en: The proposed data construction framework provides large-scale, diverse, and quality-controlled supervision across heterogeneous OCR capabilities by integrating real-world resources, controllable synthesis, and model-assisted annotation. Building upon this foundation, Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO) further enhances model capabilities through adaptive coordination of outcome-based policy optimization and on-policy distillation. By dynamically allocating teacher supervision according to the evolving competence boundary between teacher and student models, CGPO improves the effectiveness of reinforcement learning and knowledge transfer under heterogeneous OCR tasks.
blocks.zh: 拟议的数据构建框架通过整合现实世界资源、可控制的合成和模型辅助说明,为不同OCR能力提供大规模、多样和质量控制的监督。 在这一基础上,能力导向政策优化(CGPO)通过基于成果的政策优化和政策提炼的适应性协调,进一步提高模型能力。 通过根据教师和学生模式之间不断发展的能力界限动态分配教师监督,CGPO提高了在多样化的OCR任务下加强学习和知识转让的有效性.

blocks.en: Extensive evaluations on OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, OmniDocBench v1.6, MDPBench, and the in-house KIE benchmark demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves strong and balanced performance across text recognition, localization, structured document understanding, multilingual parsing, and real-world information extraction. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed unified training framework and highlight the feasibility of developing OCR foundation models capable of generalizing across diverse text-containing visual environments while maintaining competitive performance with specialized OCR systems.
blocks.zh: 对OCR Bench v2.1、CC-OCR、OmniDoc Bench v1.6、MDP Bench以及内部的KIE基准的广泛评价表明,PolyOCR在文本识别、本地化、结构化文件理解、多语种解析和现实世界信息提取等方面都取得了有力和平衡的业绩。 这些成果验证了拟议统一培训框架的有效性,并突出了开发OCR基础模型的可行性,这种模型能够将包含各种文本的视觉环境概括起来,同时与专门的OCR系统保持竞争力。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on further strengthening fundamental OCR capabilities, such as fine-grained text perception, localization, and recognition, while advancing semantic understanding and reasoning beyond text extraction. Enhancing the generalization and robustness of OCR foundation models in diverse and complex real-world environments remains a key direction toward more reliable text-centric visual intelligence.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于进一步加强基本的OCR能力,如精细的文本感知,本地化和识别,同时推进语义理解和推理,超越文本提取. 加强OCR基础模型在多样和复杂的现实世界环境中的通俗化和稳健性,仍然是更可靠的文本中心视觉智能的关键方向.

blocks.en: 8.2 Supervised Fine-Tuning Configuration
blocks.zh: 8.2 监督的微调配置

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning jointly trains the model across text recognition, localization, spotting, key information extraction, document and table parsing, formula recognition, translation, and OCR-centric reasoning.

blocks.en: Both PolyOCR-2B and PolyOCR-9B use the same SFT configuration: ms-swift ( swift sft ) with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 on 16 nodes with 16 GPU workers per node. We update the language-model parameters in full-tuning mode while freezing the vision encoder and multimodal aligner. Training uses BF16 and the flash_attention_3 attention implementation. The model and prompt-template types are both qwen3_5 ; non-thinking prefixes are enabled, and empty thinking spans are excluded from the loss through ignore_empty_think . The training mixture follows the 60M-instance, three-phase schedule in Section 4.2 .

blocks.en: 9.1 Normalization Order
blocks.zh: 9.1 正常化顺序

blocks.en: Verifier preprocessing follows a fixed order: output parsing, schema validation, task-specific canonicalization, reference-prediction matching, and scalar scoring. Parsing failures and out-of-schema outputs receive zero reward. Canonicalization removes representational differences that do not change the task answer, but does not repair missing fields, hallucinated content, invalid coordinates, or incorrect structure. For all rule-based verifiers, the release will include unit tests covering exact matches, partial matches, malformed outputs, duplicated predictions, and empty outputs.
blocks.zh: 校验器预处理遵循固定的顺序:输出解析,schema验证,任务特异性立体化,参考预测匹配,以及scalar评分. 解析失败和退出schema产出得到的回报为零. Canonicalization消除了代表差异,这些差异不会改变任务答案,但不会修复缺失的字段,幻觉内容,无效坐标,或错误的结构. 对所有基于规则的校验者,发布内容将包括涵盖精确匹配,部分匹配,错误输出,重复预测,以及空输出的单位测试.

blocks.en: 9.2 LLM-Judge Controls
blocks.zh: 9.2 LLM - 法官控制

blocks.en: LLM judges are used only when deterministic surface matching does not adequately capture semantic correctness, including translation and selected open-ended VQA tasks. The judge receives the task instruction, reference answer, and model prediction, and returns a constrained continuous score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We use Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite with deterministic decoding. The final release will record the exact model version, prompt, decoding parameters, retry policy, and evaluation date. Judge failures are logged and rerun under the same frozen configuration.
blocks.zh: LLM 判断器仅在确定表面匹配不能充分捕捉语义正确性时使用,包括翻译和选定的开放式VQA任务. 法官收到任务指令,参考答案和模型预测,并返回[0,1] [0,1] 的受限连续得分. 我们用双子座3.5-Flash-Lite 定型解码。 最终发行将记录准确的模型版本,即时,解码参数,重试政策和评价日期. 法官的失败被记录下来,并在相同的冻结配置下重新运行。
