blocks.en: 11 OCRBench v2.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 11 OCR Bench v2.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate OCR capabilities, we adopt OCRBench v2 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) as one of our primary evaluation benchmarks. OCRBench v2 is a large-scale bilingual, text-centric benchmark with 10,000 human-verified question-answer pairs spanning diverse visual scenarios. Throughout this report, subtask counts follow the evaluation export: 30 language-specific subtasks, comprising 21 English and 9 Chinese subtasks. These are aggregated into 13 language-specific task groups, comprising 8 English and 5 Chinese groups.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估OCR能力,我们采用OCR Bench v2(Fu等人,2025年)作为我们的首要评价基准之一。 OCR Bench v2是一个大规模双语,以文字为中心的基准,有10,000个人验证的问答对,跨越了多种视觉情景. 在整个报告过程中,子任务计数跟随评价导出:30个语言专用子任务,包括21个英文和9个中文子任务. 这些组合分为13个语言特定工作组,包括8个英文组和5个中文组。

blocks.en: To further improve evaluation reliability and consistency, we conduct a systematic audit of both benchmark annotations and the official evaluation protocol. Our analysis identifies two aspects that may affect evaluation robustness: (i) annotation noise and format inconsistencies in reference answers, and (ii) evaluation criteria that may not fully align with the intended semantic objectives of certain OCR tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步提高评价的可靠性和一致性,我们系统地审计基准说明和正式评价协议。 我们的分析确定了可能影响评价稳健性的两个方面:(一) 参考答复中的注释噪音和格式不一致之处;(二) 可能不完全符合某些OCR任务的预期语义目标的评价标准。

blocks.en: Based on this analysis, we introduce OCRBench v2.1 , a refined version of the benchmark that retains the original 10,000 samples and uses the same 30-subtask reporting scheme while incorporating manually verified annotation corrections and revised evaluation procedures. The refinement focuses on improving reference quality and metric consistency, without modifying the benchmark composition, task distribution, or evaluation scope.
blocks.zh: 基于这一分析,我们引入了OCR Bench v2.1.,这是保留10 000个原始样本的精细基准,采用了同样的30个子任务报告计划,同时纳入了人工核实的注释更正和订正评价程序。 改进的重点是提高参考质量和衡量一致性,同时不改变基准构成、任务分配或评价范围。

blocks.en: All models reported in this work are re-evaluated under the OCRBench v2.1 protocol to ensure fair comparison. Detailed descriptions of annotation refinement and metric revisions are provided in Sections 11.1 and 11.2 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 根据OCR Bench v2.1协议重新评价了这项工作中报告的所有模型,以确保公平比较。 第11.1节和第11.2节分别详细说明了说明的改进和总的修订。

blocks.en: 11.1 Annotation Cleaning

High-quality reference annotations are essential for reliable OCR evaluation, particularly for tasks involving structured prediction and semantic understanding. Under the original evaluation protocol, certain annotation issues may have limited impact because some metrics emphasize structural similarity or partial matching. However, under stricter content-aware evaluation, inaccurate references or inconsistent output formats can introduce additional penalties unrelated to the actual model capability.
blocks.zh: 高质量的参考说明对于可靠的OCR评价至关重要,尤其是对于涉及结构化预测和语义理解的任务而言。 根据最初的评价协议,某些注释问题可能影响有限,因为有些衡量标准强调结构相似或部分匹配. 然而,在更严格的内容意识评价下,不准确的引用或不一致的产出格式可能会引入与实际模型能力无关的额外惩罚.

blocks.en: In addition, ambiguous task instructions and inconsistent answer serialization may affect the stability of automated evaluation procedures, especially for structured outputs such as JSON, HTML, and field-value extraction. Therefore, improving annotation consistency is a necessary step toward more reliable and reproducible benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 此外,模糊的任务指令和不一致的回答序列化可能会影响自动化评价程序的稳定性,特别是对JSON,HTML等结构化产出,以及场值提取. 因此,改进说明的一致性是朝着更可靠和可复制的基准评价迈出的必要一步。

blocks.en: We conduct a comprehensive audit of all 10,000 samples, covering questions, answers, evaluation configurations, bounding boxes, and reference contents. The audit results in revisions to 2,449 samples (24.5%) . No samples are added or removed, and the original indices, task categories, bounding boxes, and evaluation configurations remain unchanged. All modifications are restricted to the question and answer fields and are manually inspected for verification.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有10,000个样本进行全面审计,涵盖问题、答案、评价配置、边框和参考内容。 审计结果对2 449个样本(24.5%)作了修订。 没有添加或删除样本,原始索引、任务类别、边框和评价配置保持不变。 所有修改均限于问答字段,并经过人工检查核查.

blocks.en: The annotation revisions can be categorized into three types, summarized in Table 14 : (A) format normalization, which improves structural consistency without changing the underlying semantics; (B) reference correction, which fixes inaccurate or incomplete ground-truth answers; and (C) instruction refinement, which reduces ambiguity in task descriptions and output requirements.
blocks.zh: 注释修订可分为三类,概括于表14:(A)格式正常化,在不改变基本语义的情况下提高结构一致性;(B)参考校正,纠正不准确或不完整的地面真实答案;(C)改进指令,减少任务说明和产出要求的模糊性。

blocks.en: Table 14: Annotation revisions in OCRBench v2.1. Type A normalizes answer serialization without changing semantics; Type B corrects genuinely wrong references; Type C rewrites extraction instructions to remove ambiguity. “#mod” counts revised samples per type; a sample modified in both question and answer is counted once in each type, so the column sums slightly exceed the 2,449 unique revised samples.
blocks.zh: 表14:OCR Bench v2.1中的说明修订。 类型 常态解答序列化而不改变语义; B 类型校正真实错误的引用; C 类型重写提取指令以消除模糊性. “#mod”计算每类订正样品;在问答中修改的样品在每类中计算一次,因此列总和略高于2,449个独特的订正样品。

blocks.en: We remove redundant formatting noise and standardize structured annotations to improve evaluation consistency without changing their semantic content. For table parsing, we eliminate scattered CSS styles, wrapper elements, and non-essential attributes, retaining only the basic HTML tags required to represent table structures. For other structured tasks, chart parsing and key-information-mapping references are converted from Python-dict-style representations into valid JSON strings, and text-grounding coordinates are uniformly serialized to ensure consistent parsing and matching during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们删除了多余的格式化噪音,并标准化了结构化的说明,以提高评价的一致性,同时又不改变其语义内容。 对于表格解析,我们取消了分散的CSS样式,包装元素,以及非基本属性,仅保留代表表格结构所需的基本HTML标记. 对于其他结构化任务,图表解析和密钥信息映射参考文献从Python-dict风格的表示转换为有效的JSON字符串,文本解析坐标统一序列,以确保评价期间的解析和匹配一致.

blocks.en: We correct inaccurate or incomplete reference annotations identified during manual inspection. These corrections mainly occur in multiple-choice reasoning tasks, key information extraction, and text translation.
blocks.zh: 我们纠正人工检查中发现的不准确或不完整的参考说明。 这些更正主要发生在多选择推理任务,关键信息提取,以及文本翻译中.

blocks.en: Typical corrections include erroneous option labels in mathematical reasoning questions, swapped or inaccurate field values in KIE annotations, OCR-related text corrections, unified formatting of currency symbols, and revised translation references. For cases where multiple answers are semantically acceptable, all valid alternatives are explicitly enumerated and supported by the v2.1 evaluation protocol (see Section 11.2 ).
blocks.zh: 典型的更正包括数学推理问题中的选项标签错误,KIE说明中的互换或不准确的字段值,OCR相关的文本更正,货币符号的统一格式化,以及订正的翻译参考. 对于多种答案可完全接受的情况,所有有效替代品都明确列出,并得到v2.1评价协议的支持(见第11.2节)。

blocks.en: We refine task instructions for key information extraction, where ambiguous extraction requirements may introduce uncertainty beyond the actual recognition and extraction capability.
blocks.zh: 我们完善关键信息提取的任务说明,其中模糊的提取要求可能会带来超出实际识别和提取能力的不确定性.

blocks.en: For English KIE samples, we rewrite all 400 questions into a unified template that explicitly specifies the target fields to extract. For Chinese KIE samples, we append explicit JSON-format requirements and normalize field naming conventions for 184 questions. These refinements ensure that extraction metrics primarily reflect the model’s ability to identify and organize information from visual inputs, rather than its interpretation of underspecified output formats.
blocks.zh: 对于英语的KIE样本,我们把所有400个问题重写成一个统一模板,明确指定要提取的目标字段. 对于中国的KIE样本,我们附上明确的JSON格式要求,并使184个问题的场命名公约正常化。 这些改进确保提取指标主要反映模型识别和整理来自视觉投入的信息的能力,而不是其对未指定产出格式的解释。

blocks.en: 11.2 Metric Revisions
blocks.zh: 11.2 计量修订

blocks.en: To improve the reliability and task alignment of evaluation, we revise the metrics for several OCRBench v2 subtasks where the original criteria may not fully reflect the intended capability being measured. Table 15 summarizes the differences between the original v2 protocol and the v2.1 evaluation scheme.
blocks.zh: 为提高评价的可靠性和任务一致性,我们修改了若干OCR Bench v2子任务的衡量标准,因为原先的标准可能没有充分反映所衡量的预期能力。 表15总结了原v2协议与v2.1评价计划之间的差异.

blocks.en: All remaining subtasks retain the original evaluation metrics, including exact matching / ANLS for VQA ( Biten et al., 2019 ) , TEDS for tables ( Zhong et al., 2020 ) , IoU-based metrics for grounding and spotting, F1 for information extraction, and normalized L1 for counting. The official aggregation strategy, including the 13 task groups and English/Chinese overall scores, is also preserved. Therefore, the reported differences arise only from the refined annotations and revised evaluation criteria described below.
blocks.zh: 所有剩余子任务都保留了原有的评价度量衡,包括VQA的精确匹配/ANLS(Biten等人,2019年),表的TEDS( Zh等人,2020年),基于IoU的度量衡用于地基和定点,F1用于信息提取,L1用于计数的规范化. 官方汇总战略,包括13个任务组和英文/中文总分,也得到保留。 因此,所报告的差异只产生于下文所述的经过改进的说明和订正的评价标准。

blocks.en: Table 15: Metric revisions from OCRBench v2 to v2.1. Only the listed subtasks are revised; other subtasks follow the official evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表15:从OCR Bench v2到v2.1的计量修订. 只有列出的子任务被修改;其他子任务遵循官方的评价协议.

blocks.en: The original scorer determines correctness based on whether the reference formula appears as a substring of the prediction after removing whitespace. This criterion may be insufficient for formula understanding, as it can accept incomplete semantic matches while rejecting visually equivalent formulations with different LaTeX syntax.
blocks.zh: 原始计分器根据参考公式是否在去除白空间后作为预测的子字符串出现来确定正确性. 这个标准可能不足以理解公式,因为它可以接受不完整的语义匹配,同时拒绝具有不同LaTeX语法的视觉等效配体.

blocks.en: We replace it with CDM ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , where both reference and prediction formulas are rendered and compared at the visual token level. The metric performs token matching with geometric verification and computes an F 1 F_{1} score: F 1 CDM = 2 ​ P ​ R P + R , P = | M | | T p | , R = | M | | T g | , F_{1}^{\mathrm{CDM}}=\frac{2PR}{P+R},\qquad P=\frac{|M|}{|T_{p}|},\quad R=\frac{|M|}{|T_{g}|}, (14) where T p T_{p} and T g T_{g} denote the visual tokens of the prediction and reference, and M M represents the verified token matches.

blocks.en: This evaluation is more robust to common LaTeX syntax variations while remaining sensitive to the visual correctness of mathematical expressions.
blocks.zh: 这个评价对常见的LaTeX语法变异更为有力,同时对数学表达式的视觉正确性保持敏感.

blocks.en: The original implementation evaluates document parsing mainly through structural similarity. While this captures high-level organization, it provides limited assessment of whether the recovered textual content is correct.
blocks.zh: 最初的实施主要通过结构相似性来评估文档的解析. 虽然这捕捉到高层组织,但对收回的文字内容是否正确提供了有限的评估.

blocks.en: The original protocol combines multiple metrics, including BLEU, METEOR, token-level F 1 F_{1} , and edit distance. However, for OCR recognition tasks with relatively short outputs, these metrics may provide inconsistent signals and lack a unified interpretation.

blocks.en:
LLM-based assessment has been studied for both reference-based and reference-free translation evaluation ( Kocmi and Federmann, 2023 ) .
Translation quality is primarily determined by semantic preservation rather than surface-level word overlap. Therefore, n n -gram based metrics may not fully capture acceptable paraphrases, synonym substitutions, or different word orders.
blocks.zh:
对基于参考和无参考翻译评价的LLM评估进行了研究(Kocmi和Federmann, 2023年)。
翻译质量主要通过语义保存而不是表层词重叠来决定. 因此,n-gram基的度量法可能无法完全捕捉可接受的释义,同义词替代,或不同的单词顺序.

blocks.en: We evaluate translation quality using an LLM-based judge, Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite , with the fixed evaluation prompt shown in Figure 6 . The judge evaluates semantic equivalence while considering translation completeness, factual consistency, and target-language correctness. The output score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] is directly used as the sample-level evaluation score. For samples with multiple acceptable references, the maximum score over references is adopted.
blocks.zh: 我们使用基于LLM的法官双子座3.5-Flash-Lite来评价翻译质量,固定的评价提示如图6所示。 法官评估语义等同性,同时考虑翻译的完整性,事实一致性,以及目标语言的正确性. [0, 1] [0, 1] 中的输出分数直接用作样本级评价分数. 对于有多种可接受参考文献的样本,采用比参考文献最高分.

blocks.zh: 图6 法官在OCR Bench v2.1中使用的文本翻译子任务提示. {预测}和{回答}分别被模型输出和一个参考翻译所取代.

blocks.en: Some reasoning VQA samples may contain multiple semantically acceptable answers. The original evaluation protocol assumes a single reference answer, which may introduce unnecessary penalties for such cases.
blocks.zh: 一些推理的VQA样本可能包含多个可成体接受的答案. 最初的评价协议假设一个单一的参考答案,这可能为此类案件引入不必要的处罚.

blocks.en: The v2.1 scorer supports multiple valid references by accepting a prediction if it matches any enumerated answer. For single-answer samples, the evaluation behavior remains unchanged. This modification improves evaluation consistency for reasoning tasks with answer ambiguity.
blocks.zh: v2.1 计分器通过接受一个预测,如果它符合任何列举的答案,支持多个有效的引用. 对于单答样本,评价行为保持不变. 这一修改提高了推理任务的评价一致性,但答案模糊.

blocks.en: 11.3 Comparability and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 11.3 可比较性和可复制性

blocks.en: The above refinements introduce two important considerations for evaluation interpretation.
blocks.zh: 上述改进为评价解释提出了两个重要考虑因素。

blocks.en: First, OCRBench v2.1 scores should not be directly compared with the original OCRBench v2 leaderboard results, since the protocol incorporates annotation corrections and revised metrics for several subtasks. All OCRBench v2.1 results reported in this work are obtained under the same refined annotations and scoring procedures.
blocks.zh: 首先,OCR Bench v2.1的分数不应直接与最初的OCR Bench v2领导板结果相比较,因为协议中包含了对多个子任务的注释校正和修改度量衡. 这项工作报告的所有OCR Bench v2.1成果都是根据同样的精细说明和评分程序取得的。

blocks.en: Second, the v2.1 evaluation pipeline is designed to be deterministic and reproducible. All metrics are computed offline with fixed procedures, with the exception of the LLM-based translation evaluator, which uses Gemini-3.5-Flash-Lite with a fixed evaluation prompt shown in Figure 6 . The refined annotations and evaluation code are released together with this report to facilitate reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 二,v2.1评价管线的设计定型,可再生产. 除基于LLM的翻译评价员使用双子座3.5-Flash-Lite的固定评价速率如图6所示外,所有衡量标准均用固定程序离线计算。 改进后的说明和评价守则将连同本报告一并发布,以便于复制。
